acceptance_predicates.description: Comparison admits only exact provider, model/settings, endpoint, generation, agent, and workload identity matches.
Every identity mismatch yields a stable unavailable reason in human and --json output.
Mismatched comparison candidates never trigger provider calls, mock substitution, or silent pairing.
Development authentication, signatures, and keys remain warning-only outside the comparison identity fence.

definition_of_done: Matching and provider/settings/endpoint/generation mismatch matrices pass.
Symmetric/asymmetric/multi-candidate coverage, privacy, independent review, and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Online/offline result members and identity metadata.
Reviewed campaign/run generation and endpoint identity.

gates.description: Only exact provider, model, endpoint, generation, agent, and workload matches compare.
Mismatches produce typed unavailable diagnostics without provider fallback.
